# Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

August 11, 2026

Only one-third (33%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of how Donald Trump is handling his job as president, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's the smallest share to ever approve of Trump's job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump's terms. Meanwhile 62% disapprove of Trump, the most to ever do so. ## Timeline

Aug. 16Trump had a 35% approval rating and 55% disapproval rating in a Financial Times/Focaldata poll of 1,913 registered voters conducted Aug. 7-10 (margin of error 2.9).

Trump’s net approval rating among Republicans has dropped eight points since the groups’ survey last month, the Financial Times reported. [...] July 30Trump had a 38.2% approval rating and 58.8% disapproval rating, for a -20.6% net approval rating in Nate Silver’s poll tracker—a record low for his second term, following two surveys released Wednesday that logged record-low ratings for Trump.

His net approval has dropped from -16.4% on July 12.
